COLDWAR_SOV_alive_kos = {
	# COLDWAR SP UNDATED kos
	OR = {
		AND = {
			COLDWAR_SP_1970_human_sov = yes
			NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Nikolai Ryzhkov" ruling_only = yes } }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { COLDWAR_SP_1970_human_sov = yes }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_dead_kos }
			date < 1980.12.18
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_SOV_standin_kos = {
	NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_alive_kos = yes }
}

# a republic may apply for a seat at the next Party Congress
COLDWAR_SOV_can_apply = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat }
	NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_slanderer }
	NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applied }
	has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applications_open
}
